latest_release.name: v2.3.1
latest_release.body:
## Known issues

- **Mac users on 2.3.0 or earlier:** Your current version can't install this update. Download 2.3.1 from the [downloads page](https://www.surfsense.com/downloads) and install it. Your data stays as it is. After that, updates install in the app as usual.
- **Windows and Linux** update in the app as before.

## What's Changed
* fix(www): load the homepage without a white band or a heavy footer by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2384
* docs(www): write the SurfSense 2.0 user docs on Fumadocs' Spacious layout by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2383
* docs(www): ship the 2.0 user docs and the homepage loading fixes by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2385
* fix(desktop): install Mac updates over 1 GiB with Electron 44.10.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2387
* docs(changelog): v2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2388
* chore(local): release 2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2389
* [Local|Release] Release desktop 2.3.1 by @AnishSarkar22 in https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/pull/2390


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MODSetter/SurfSense/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1
